text: In order to move the business of this subcommittee forward in order to deal with, in a more timely manner, the growing crisis of the loss of affordable housing, it is important to discuss details of our next meeting.

The Subcommittee on the Protection of Affordable Rental Housing: 1. Requested the Chair to work with the Clerk to schedule the next meeting of the Subcommittee on the Protection of Affordable Rental Housing in the early fall 2019.
